title: 第13章 不安的预感天才妹妹第14章 暴涨我的极限二合一
slug: 幕后黑手我的词条邪到发癫
content_zh:
没等冯矩说完，冯睦便一口打断：“不用，我已经答应同学，过两天就去焚化厂上班。”
冯矩眉头皱成疙瘩，冷笑一声就要驳斥。
滴滴。
手机上传来短讯，在催促他归队，他今天只是巡逻正好路过，回家拿些换洗衣服。
“我在外面吃过了，有点累先回房休息了，以后每月的工资，我会拿出一半交给家里的，你放心。”
冯睦没心思跟冯矩吵架，至于上缴一半工资，是不愿激化矛盾，彻底惹毛冯矩。
那样不明智，对自己当前的生存处境没有益处，就当是偿还借住这具身体，寄宿三年的食宿费吧。
等他有能力偿清的时候，就是他搬离之日，他相信，那一天不会太远了。
冯矩低头回复完队里，就准备再教训下冯睦，却看见后者已经自顾自回屋，卧室门都合上半边了。
冯矩脸皮抽搐，骂道：“逆子，没能力还不服管教。”
王秀丽连忙劝慰：“好了好了，你不是着急回队里，过段时间再说吧。”
冯矩压住怒意，叮嘱了两句：“你在家里看好他，最近晚上都少出门，最近哪哪都不太平，九区也潜入了一伙极恶组织的危险分子。”
冯矩仓促间叮嘱两句，临出门时，余光扫了眼茶几上的毕业证。
皱巴巴的。
等一下，皱巴的？
不太对，不是毕业证，而是冯睦好像跟以往有哪里不太一样了。
冯睦站在卧室门后，随手关掩门的动作微微一顿，然后又缓缓的关上。
“极恶组织，危险分子，该不会是…..”
冯睦低头，漆黑的眸子又倒映出那条每日提醒——[当前继承进度1%，奖励已发送，请注意查收！]
一个贼荒诞，贼惊悚的猜想浮现在冯睦脑海中：“不会是组织给我派来送货的快递员吧~”

冯睦狠狠打了个激灵，心头祈祷：“可千万别是送货上门啊，艹！！！”
走到窗边拉开窗帘，他看着污水横流的窄巷子，来来往往的绰绰人影，忽然就觉得，哪哪个都行踪鬼祟，面色可疑。
全都像极是隐匿在人群里的极恶犯罪分子。
嗯。
我的身份也是潜伏中的一员。
冯睦知道自己属于有点疑神疑鬼了，但是吧，心里头那股不安的预感，就莫名的强烈。
“我还是太缺乏安全感，所以，唯有练功升级。”他想。
冯睦拉合窗帘，打开电脑，点开视频，跟随着口令，很快就沉浸入忘我的锻体操中。
疲惫，枯燥，痛苦却充实。
筋骨在拉扯中呻吟，肌肉在重复中淋漓，骨骼在吞铁中变形，时间跟随时针流淌，一圈又一圈。
动作伸展依旧不到位，姿势体型依旧难以标准，僵硬固化的筋膜依旧没能改善。
但，缓慢的动作间，空气偶尔会发出闷响，很弱很弱，被他粗喘的呼吸盖住了，冯睦并未察觉。
那是骨头隔着皮肉，正对世界发出的狰狞恶吼。
[食铁者：一阶]
[可食用铁类：1]
[可汲取金属特性：1]
[当前检测食用铁类——普通生铁，食用度10.5%。]
[已汲取特性：？？]
快了。
更快了。

今日增长4.2%，增长比昨天更快，几乎等同于第一日的双倍。
“日复一日，不中断的修炼，每天的疲惫都会累加，所以，每天的消耗也会积累，导致食用度的增长一天比一天快嘛。”
冯睦瘫在床上，浑身散架一般酸痛难忍，嘴角却咧的畅快，
“对别人而言，疲惫与痛苦是最好通过休息来清除掉的debuff，但对我而言，我却希冀debuff能无止境的叠加下去。”
content_en:
Before Feng Ju could finish speaking, Feng Mu interrupted: "No, I have promised my classmates that I will go to work at the incineration plant in two days."
Feng Ju frowned and sneered as he was about to refute.
Didi.
A text message came from his cell phone, urging him to return to the team. He was just patrolling and happened to pass by today and went home to get some changes of clothes.
"I've eaten out, and I'm a little tired. I'm going back to my room to rest. From now on, I will give half of my monthly salary to my family, don't worry."
Feng Mu had no intention of quarreling with Feng Ju. As for handing over half of his salary, he did not want to intensify the conflict and completely anger Feng Ju.
That would be unwise and not beneficial to my current living situation. Just think of it as repaying the room and board for three years of borrowing this body.
When he is able to pay off the debt, it will be the day he moves out. He believes that day will not be too far away.
After Feng Ju lowered his head and replied to the team, he was about to teach Feng Mu another lesson, but saw that the latter had already gone back to the house by himself, and the bedroom door was half closed.
Feng Ju's face twitched and he cursed: "You traitor, you don't obey discipline even if you don't have the ability."
Wang Xiuli quickly comforted her: "Okay, okay, you are not in a hurry to return to the team, let's talk about it after a while."
Feng Ju suppressed his anger and gave a few words of advice: "You should keep an eye on him at home. He has been going out less at night recently. There has been no peace everywhere recently. A group of dangerous elements from an extremely evil organization have also infiltrated into the ninth district."
Feng Ju hurriedly gave a few instructions. Before leaving the house, he glanced at the graduation certificate on the coffee table.
Crumpled.
Wait, wrinkled?
Something's not right, it's not the graduation certificate, but Feng Mu seems to be different from before.
Feng Mu stood behind the bedroom door, closing the door for a moment, then slowly closing it again.
"Extremely evil organization, dangerous elements, could they be..."
Feng Mu lowered his head, and his dark eyes reflected the daily reminder - [The current inheritance progress is 1%, the reward has been sent, please check it! ]
A ridiculous and horrifying guess appeared in Feng Mu's mind: "It can't be the courier sent by the organization to deliver the goods to me~"
Feng Mu shuddered hard and prayed in his heart: "Don't deliver it to your door, damn it!!!"
He walked to the window and opened the curtains. He looked at the narrow alley where sewage flowed, the figures coming and going, and suddenly felt that everyone was moving around and looking suspicious.
They all look like extremely vicious criminals hiding among the crowd.
Um.
My identity is also one of the lurking ones.
Feng Mu knew that he was a little suspicious, but hey, the uneasy premonition in his heart was inexplicably strong.
"I'm still too insecure, so I can only practice and upgrade." He thought.
Feng Mu closed the curtains, turned on the computer, clicked on the video, followed the command, and soon became immersed in selfless gymnastics.
Tired, boring, painful but fulfilling.
The muscles and bones groaned during the pulling, the muscles dripped with repetition, the bones deformed during the swallowing of iron, and time flowed with the hour hand, round and round.
The movement and stretching are still not in place, the posture and body shape are still difficult to standard, and the stiff and solidified fascia has not been improved.
However, during the slow movements, the air occasionally made a muffled sound, which was very weak. It was covered by his heavy breathing, and Feng Mu did not notice it.
That is the ferocious roar that the bones are making at the world through the skin and flesh.
[Iron Eater: Level 1]
[Edible iron: 1]
[Extractable metal properties: 1]
[Currently tested edible iron - ordinary pig iron, edible content 10.5%. ]
[Characteristics learned:? ? ]
Soon.
Faster.
Today's growth is 4.2%, which is faster than yesterday and almost double the first day's growth.
"Day after day, without interruption, the fatigue will accumulate every day, so the daily consumption will also accumulate, causing the consumption to increase faster day by day."
Feng Mu lay paralyzed on the bed, his whole body falling apart in unbearable pain, but his mouth was grinning freely.Quick,
"For others, fatigue and pain are debuffs that are best removed through rest, but for me, I hope that the debuffs can be stacked endlessly."
